item.title: United Communications Secures $230M Loan to Accelerate Fiber Expansion
item.description: United Communications, Middle Tennessee’s leading fiber internet provider, today announced it has closed a $230 million credit facility with CoBank to further accelerate the company’s ongoing fiber broadband expansion across the region.
